subject: Alert not triggering on threshold breach
body: Hi, we have a threshold alert set up for our monthly budget variance report and it did not fire this week even though the threshold was clearly exceeded. The data in the dashboard looks correct, so I do not think this is a data issue. Can you check what happened? Sanna Koskinen

subject: API rate limit error - 429 on standard calls
body: We are getting 429 responses on our scheduled API pulls. These are the same calls we have been running for months, nothing has changed on our side. Please advise. Sanna Koskinen

subject: Dashboard loading very slowly
body: Our main finance dashboard is taking over 40 seconds to load this week. This started around Monday. The underlying data volume has not changed significantly. Is there something on the platform side? Sanna Koskinen

subject: Dashboard filters keep resetting
body: Q4 dashboard date filters reset on every refresh, team resets constantly. Same dashboards that were slow in November. Sanna.

subject: Alert emails going to spam / not delivering
body: We noticed that our budget alerts have not been arriving. Checked and they are landing in spam for several users. This is the second alert issue we have had - first the threshold wasn't triggering, now deliverability. Can you check your sending domain setup? We rely on these notifications. Sanna Koskinen

subject: ERP connector sync failing since Jan 15
body: Our ERP connector has been failing since the 15th. The error log shows a timeout on the data pull. This connector syncs overnight and we need it working for morning reporting. Sanna Koskinen

subject: Scheduler down AGAIN
body: Weekly P&L export didn't run last night. Third module issue this month. Finance is manually pulling data. Escalate. Sanna.

subject: Alerts lost after platform update
body: Three configured alerts gone after last weekend's update. Recurring alert issues since August — non-firing, spam, now missing configs entirely. Sanna.

subject: API authentication breaking every few days
body: Our API tokens are expiring unpredictably - not on the documented schedule. This breaks our integration and someone has to manually regenerate. We had rate limit issues in October and now token stability. I need this looked at properly. Sanna Koskinen

subject: Alert threshold value not saving
body: When we update the threshold on one of our alerts the new value does not persist after saving. Please check. Sanna Koskinen

subject: Conditional formatting not applying in report
body: Conditional formatting rules we set in the report builder are not rendering in the exported PDF. They display correctly in the preview. Sanna Koskinen

subject: Pagination broken on /reports endpoint
body: The cursor-based pagination on the /reports endpoint is returning duplicate records on page 2. This started some time in April. Can you advise on a workaround and when a fix is expected? Sanna Koskinen

subject: Report builder date range picker
body: The date range picker in report builder defaults to last 7 days every time, even after I change it and save. Expected it to remember the last selection.

subject: Connector timezone mismatch
body: Timestamps coming through our connector look to be in UTC while everything else in our account is set to CET. Causing an off-by-one-hour issue in a few of our reports.

subject: Report builder — conditional column visibility
body: Is it possible to show or hide a column based on the value of another field, rather than a fixed toggle? Trying to build a report that adapts a bit depending on the data.

subject: Alert condition - 'greater than' not working as expected
body: Setting up a new alert and the 'greater than' condition does not seem to be evaluated correctly - it fires at the wrong value. We're testing this before rolling out to the team. Matti Lehtinen

subject: Report not including all date range data
body: A report set to pull the last 90 days is missing data from the first two weeks of the range. When I query the data directly in the connector it is all there. Sigrid Larsson

subject: API response times degraded - over 8 seconds
body: Our API calls that used to return in under a second are now averaging 8-10 seconds. This has been going on for about a week and it is affecting our data pipeline. I raised this with your chat support and was told to submit a ticket. Still waiting. Matti Lehtinen

subject: SQL connector dropping columns on sync
body: Our SQL connector is syncing but two columns from our source table are not appearing in the connected dataset. We have not changed anything on the source side. This is blocking a report we need to deliver next week. Also note that the API performance issue from last month is still unresolved - we have not heard back on that. Sigrid Larsson

subject: API still slow — June ticket still open
body: Still no fix on the June API performance ticket. Response times still 8+ seconds. Two open tickets now. Matti.

subject: User deactivated by mistake - need to restore access
body: One of our active users was deactivated somehow - we did not do this intentionally. She cannot log in. Please restore her access as soon as possible, she is needed for end-of-month reporting. Sigrid Larsson

subject: Dashboard widget not refreshing on schedule
body: One of our dashboard widgets stopped auto-refreshing. The manual refresh works but the scheduled one does not. Please advise. Matti Lehtinen

subject: New user invite not sending
body: We are trying to add a new team member and the invitation email is not arriving. Tried resending twice. Sigrid Larsson

subject: Alert digest - duplicated entries
body: The weekly alert digest is sending duplicate entries for some alerts. Matti Lehtinen

subject: Report column sorting not working
body: Column sorting in our report is not functioning. Clicking the sort arrow does nothing. This is on a report that was working fine last month. Sigrid Larsson

subject: Export over year-end holidays
body: Our scheduled export is due to run over the holiday period when nobody's monitoring closely. Just want to confirm it will run as normal and land where expected — nothing urgent, more a sanity check before we're all out.

subject: Report builder currency formatting
body: Trying to get a report to display figures in both EUR and the local currency side by side. Currently it seems to only support one currency format per report.

subject: Dashboard tile comparing two periods
body: Would like a tile that shows this quarter versus the same quarter last year side by side. Not seeing an obvious way to set that comparison in the tile settings.

subject: Report builder template sharing across workspaces
body: We have two workspaces under the same account and would like to share a report template between them without rebuilding it. Is that possible currently?

subject: Alert snooze option
body: Is there a way to temporarily snooze an alert for a known, expected anomaly rather than disabling it entirely and having to remember to turn it back on?

subject: API key permissions question
body: Quick question - we have an API key set up with read access and we want to know if it is possible to scope it to specific endpoints only rather than all read endpoints. Is that a supported option? Sanna Leinonen

subject: Dashboard sharing with client
body: We would like to share one dashboard view with an external client, read-only. Is this possible without giving them a full seat? Team is very happy with the platform so far, by the way.

subject: Dashboard for year overview
body: Building a year-end overview dashboard and it is coming together nicely. One question — can I combine data from three different date ranges into one tile, for a before/after comparison?

subject: Alert for new product line
body: We are launching alerts for our new product line this month. Quick question on threshold setup — can it use a rolling average instead of a fixed number?

subject: Feature idea: seat groups
body: Would be very useful to group seats by department for easier permission management, instead of setting each user one by one. We have almost 20 users now and it is getting harder to manage.

subject: Feature idea: sandbox API key
body: For testing purpose, would be great to have a sandbox API key that does not count against our production rate limit. We are building an internal tool and testing eats into our normal quota.

subject: Following up on export ideas
body: Coming back after a busy period — still interested in the better export retention settings we discussed before. In the meantime, quick question: can scheduled exports include a cover sheet with report metadata?

subject: Alert working great, one small tweak
body: The rolling average alert has been working very well since we set it up. Small tweak request — could the alert email include a small chart, not just the number?

subject: Report builder vs. our old Storsund BI setup
body: Just wanted to say the report builder has come a long way from when we first moved off Storsund BI last year — the calculated fields especially are much easier to work with now. One small question on nested grouping, otherwise team is very satisfied.

subject: API — filtering reports by tag
body: Is there a way to filter the /reports endpoint by tag rather than pulling everything and filtering client-side? Would simplify our integration nicely.

subject: Report builder — quick formatting question
body: Been a while since our last ticket, everything's been running smoothly. Quick one — is there a way to apply a number format to an entire column at once rather than cell by cell?

subject: Feature request: alert history export
body: Would be useful to export a history of past alert triggers for a given rule, for audit purposes. Currently I only see the most recent trigger in the UI.

subject: Following up on report builder formatting
body: Following up on the column formatting question from a couple months back — the workaround you suggested has worked fine. New question: is there a way to lock certain columns from being resized by other editors?

subject: Dashboard year-end wrap-up question
body: Wrapping up the year and want to build a summary dashboard pulling highlights from across our reports. Is there a way to pull a single KPI value from a different report into a dashboard tile?

subject: New seat needed for incoming controller
body: Hi, we have a new financial controller starting Monday and need a seat added to our Standard plan. Could you also revoke access for Janne Koski, who left the team in June? Thanks in advance.

subject: Scheduled report never arrived
body: Our monthly management report was scheduled to send on the 1st but nobody received it. Can you check the scheduler settings on our account? Happy to send a screenshot of the setup if useful.

subject: NetSuite connector showing auth error
body: The NetSuite connector has been throwing an 'auth expired' error since Monday morning. Reconnecting doesn't seem to help. Could someone take a look?

subject: Connector auth error back again
body: The same NetSuite auth expired error I reported in August is happening again, this time twice in one week. Is something on our end causing the token to keep dropping, or is this on your side?

subject: SSO group mapping for new seats
body: We're onboarding four new seats this month and want to map them to our existing SSO groups rather than creating individual logins. Can you confirm whether group-based role assignment is supported for Admin & seats on the Professional plan, and if so, point me to the config docs or set it up on your end? We use Azure AD as our IdP. Would like this in place before the new starters' first day, 18 March. Mikael

subject: Role permissions not saving correctly
body: When I set a custom role restricting export access for one of our analyst seats, the permission reverts to default (export enabled) after about a day. Reproduced twice, most recently 3 May, ~14:00 CET, role 'Analyst — restricted', account admin panel. We're evaluating a couple of alternatives for next year including Storsund BI, partly on the strength of their more granular permissions model, so a proper fix here would help make the comparison fair. Logs available on request. Mikael

subject: Connector auth token revoked without notice
body: Our warehouse connector's auth token was revoked overnight on 3–4 July with no notification, which broke the sync until I re-authenticated manually this morning. This is the second admin-side surprise in a few months, after the permissions issue in May. We're continuing our evaluation of Storsund BI as part of the broader tooling review, and reliability of connector auth is one of the things we're weighing directly against what we've experienced here. Not asking for anything beyond a fix and, ideally, some warning next time. Mikael

subject: PowerPoint export - brand colours
body: Quick question: when we export dashboards to PowerPoint, is there a way to apply our own colour palette instead of the default? Not a big deal, just tidying things up before a board pack. Exports have been noticeably faster since the last release, by the way.

subject: 12 new seats for Stockholm office
body: We're opening a Stockholm office next month and need 12 new Enterprise seats provisioned. Could you send the bulk onboarding template we used last time? As always, appreciate the quick turnaround.

subject: Feature idea: percentage-based alert thresholds
body: Right now our alerts only trigger on absolute values, but for a few KPIs we'd rather set a percentage change threshold, e.g. revenue down more than 10% week over week. Is this on the roadmap, or is there a workaround we're missing?

subject: Saved custom date range presets
body: Following on from the alerts conversation, it would help if we could save custom date ranges as presets on dashboards rather than resetting them every session. A few of our regional leads have asked for the same thing.

subject: Percentage alerts working well - small tweak
body: The percentage-based alert thresholds you added in September have worked really well for us. One small tweak: could the notification email include the actual percentage change, not just a flag that the threshold was crossed? Otherwise very happy with how this turned out.

subject: Widget not loading on finance dashboard
body: The revenue-by-region widget on our finance dashboard has been stuck loading for a few users since yesterday, though it works fine for others. Cleared cache, no change. Can you check on your end?

subject: Same widget issue as before
body: The revenue-by-region widget is stuck loading again, same symptom as the ticket from late November. Happening to two of my colleagues right now.

subject: Formula error in report builder
body: Getting a #REF error on a custom formula in the report builder that worked fine last quarter. I haven't changed anything on my side. Can someone check what changed?

subject: API rate limit hit during month-end close
body: We hit the API rate limit twice during month-end close last week, which delayed our automated reconciliation pull. Is there a way to request a higher limit for our account, or should we be batching calls differently?

subject: Rows missing after SAP sync
body: Noticed our SAP connector synced successfully last night but around 200 rows are missing from the cost centre report compared to source. Can you check the last sync log for our account?

subject: Formatting lost when exporting report template
body: When I export our quarterly template from the report builder to PDF, the column formatting resets to default. Looks fine in the editor. Could you take a look?

subject: API token expired without warning
body: Our integration token expired without any notice email, which broke our overnight data pull. Is there a setting to get advance warning before tokens expire?

subject: Custom formula throwing errors
body: A custom formula in one of our report templates has started throwing errors intermittently - works some days, fails others. Wanted to flag that it's been open a couple of weeks now, in case it's slipped through.

subject: Budget variance alert not triggering
body: We set up an alert to flag when actuals vary from budget by more than 5%, but it hasn't fired even though we breached that a couple of weeks ago. Can you check the configuration?

subject: Dashboard blank since this morning
body: Dashboard's been blank since 8am, just a loading spinner. Whole team is blocked on the Monday numbers. Please fix now.

subject: Now exports aren't working either
body: Export button just spins, nothing downloads. Second thing broken in two days. Need this today.

subject: Report builder frozen on save
body: Report builder hangs every time I hit save. Three separate things broken this week now.

subject: Can't add a seat, page just errors
body: Trying to add a seat and the admin page throws a generic error. Not a great week for this platform, honestly.

subject: Seat provisioning broken
body: New seat I added yesterday still shows pending, and the user can't log in. You usually get these sorted fast once someone looks, but I shouldn't have to chase every time. Needed them active for a client call this morning.

subject: Connector down too now
body: Now the Salesforce connector's failing as well. Same day as the seat issue. Bit much.

subject: Export missing half the rows
body: Exported the client report and it's missing roughly half the rows compared to what's on screen. Already sent it to a client before I noticed. Not good.

subject: Locked out of admin settings
body: Getting a permissions error trying to open admin settings even though I'm the account owner. Started this morning.

subject: Report builder error again
body: Same freeze-on-save issue from September is back in the report builder. Please escalate this one, it's happened multiple times now.

subject: Still broken this morning
body: Report builder still won't save this morning. Yesterday's fix didn't hold.

subject: Report builder crashed mid-edit
body: Lost twenty minutes of work when the report builder crashed without saving a draft. Can autosave be looked at properly rather than patched again?

subject: Dashboard showing stale data
body: Dashboard's showing numbers from two days ago, refresh does nothing. Client meeting in an hour.

subject: API errors right after yesterday's fix
body: Fixed the dashboard yesterday, thanks for the quick turn, but now our API calls are throwing 500s. Feels like whack-a-mole at the moment.

subject: Alerts firing twice for the same event
body: Getting duplicate alert emails for the same threshold breach, three or four times over. Please stop the noise.

subject: Alert config reset itself
body: On top of the duplicate alerts, my alert configuration from last week has reset back to defaults. Nothing changed on my end.

subject: How to transfer account ownership?
body: Hi, one of our admins is leaving the company in January and we need to transfer account ownership to another user. What is the process for this? Jens Heikkinen

subject: API - 'created_at' field missing from response
body: The 'created_at' field is not appearing in the API response for the /datasets endpoint even though the documentation says it should be there. Jens Heikkinen

subject: Alert - minimum threshold value not accepted
body: When setting a threshold below 1 (e.g. 0.5) the field rejects the value and snaps to 1. We need to set thresholds on percentage-based metrics. Jens Heikkinen

subject: Connector - sync schedule changed without action from us
body: Our data connector was set to sync every 4 hours and it now appears to be on a daily schedule. We did not change this. Jens Heikkinen

subject: Report - grand total row not included in PDF export
body: The grand total row at the bottom of our report renders in the browser but is missing in the PDF export. Jens Heikkinen

subject: Dashboard load time very slow
body: Dashboards are taking 15-20 seconds to load for our team since this week, previously near-instant. Nothing changed on our network side as far as I can tell.

subject: SSO login failing for two users
body: Two users are getting an SSO error when logging in, rest of the team is fine. Can you check the SAML config on our account?

subject: Export button greyed out in report builder
body: The export button in report builder is greyed out for one of our editors, though he has the right permissions elsewhere. Anyone else seeing this?

subject: Dashboard load times still an issue
body: Following up on the slow load times from earlier this month - still happening, particularly on the operations dashboard with the larger dataset. Would like to understand root cause rather than a workaround.

subject: Permissions issue in report builder
body: The export button issue is now happening for a second user. Might be worth checking if it's tied to a specific permission group.

subject: Report builder timing out on large reports
body: Reports over roughly 50 pages are timing out before they finish rendering. Not urgent, but we run one of these monthly and it's becoming a routine annoyance.

subject: Dashboard filters not persisting
body: Filters we set on the operations dashboard reset every time we log back in. Would be useful if they stuck per user.

subject: API returning inconsistent timestamps
body: Noticed the API returns timestamps in UTC for some endpoints and local time for others. Causing small mismatches in our downstream pipeline. Worth documenting at least.

subject: Export to Excel missing a tab
body: When exporting our multi-sheet report to Excel, one of the tabs is missing from the download. Works fine in the on-screen preview.

subject: Excel export issue again
body: Picking this up on the IT side - we're seeing the same missing-tab issue Matti flagged back in the autumn, this time on a different report. Can you check if it's related?

subject: Conditional formatting not saving
body: Conditional formatting rules I set in a report template don't save after I close and reopen it. Have to redo them each time.

subject: API calls failing intermittently
body: We're seeing roughly 1 in 10 API calls fail with a timeout, no clear pattern. This is affecting our nightly data pipeline and has been going on for over a week now. Please look into this soon, our year-end reporting depends on it.

subject: Still no update on the API failures from December
body: Erik raised the intermittent API timeouts before Christmas and we still have no fix or clear explanation. Our year-end numbers were delayed because of it. This needs proper attention, not another 'we're looking into it' reply.

subject: Requesting a call with someone senior
body: Now we have a seat provisioning problem on top of everything else this year. I'd like a call scheduled with your team lead rather than going through the ticket queue again - between the API issues in January and this, we need to understand what's actually being done to stabilise our account.

subject: Small connector fix - thanks for the call in July
body: Following the call we had over the summer, things have genuinely been more stable. Small one this time: our Power BI connector needs a refresh after a permissions change. Appreciate the quick response as usual these days.

subject: Overdue invoice alerts not firing
body: We set up alerts to flag overdue invoices over 30 days but nothing has triggered despite several qualifying this month. Can you check the alert configuration?

subject: Seat downgrade still not processed
body: Requested a seat downgrade back to our normal count three weeks ago and we're still being shown the higher count. Please action this, we shouldn't be paying for seats we don't use.

subject: Report builder crashing on pivot tables
body: Report builder crashes every time I try to add a pivot table to our board report. This is on top of the seat issue from last week that's still open. Getting a bit much.

subject: Report builder broken again
body: Same crash as last time, this time on a different report. Please treat this one faster than before, it's disrupting our reporting cycle.

subject: Third report builder failure this quarter
body: This is the third time report builder has failed on us since January. I don't understand how the same feature keeps breaking. We rely on this for board reporting.

subject: Exports failing too now
body: On top of report builder, exports are now timing out on anything over a few pages. Everything feels like it's falling apart at once. Please treat this with urgency.

subject: Need this escalated - pattern of failures
body: I'd like this formally escalated. Between December and now we've had alerts not firing, a seat request ignored for weeks, and three separate report builder crashes. Please have someone senior review our account and get back to me directly.

subject: Following up on escalation - seats issue unresolved
body: Still waiting to hear from someone on the account review I asked for last week, and the original seat count problem from January still isn't fixed. This is exactly the kind of thing I raised.

subject: Report builder down again during escalation review
body: Report builder crashed again this morning, in the middle of what I understood was supposed to be a review of our account. I need to see this stabilise, not keep restarting the same conversation.

subject: Connector question - much smaller issue than before
body: Different kind of ticket this time - just a minor sync delay on one connector. Wanted to say the account has felt noticeably more stable since the changes over the summer. This one took three days, which is more the pace we'd expect.

subject: Export formatting - small fix
body: Small formatting issue on an export, nothing like the failures earlier in the year. Fixed within a few days, appreciated.

subject: Second connector tweak
body: Another minor connector adjustment needed, same day as the export ticket. Both handled quickly, thank you.

subject: Dashboard tweak request
body: Would like a small layout change on our main dashboard - not urgent, just a nice-to-have now that things have settled down. Thanks again for how the account has been handled since the summer.

subject: Dashboard colours question
body: Following up on the dashboard change from last week, could we also update the colour scheme to match our new branding? No rush.

subject: Report builder working well - one addition
body: Genuinely good to say report builder has been rock solid since the summer. Would like to add a new template for quarterly board packs if that's straightforward.

subject: Dashboard widget request
body: Could we get a new widget added to track cash runway on the finance dashboard? Whenever convenient, no rush at all.

subject: Routine connector check
body: Just flagging a minor sync gap on the HR connector, a few records came through late. Not urgent.

subject: Dashboard access for new hire
body: New analyst starting next week will need dashboard access set up the same way as the rest of the finance team. Thanks in advance.

subject: Export formatting question
body: Loving the new export options - quick question, is there a way to default exports to landscape orientation for our team? Small thing but would save a step every time.

subject: Dashboard sharing link expired early
body: Shared a dashboard link with our board last week and it expired after two days instead of the usual month. Not urgent since I can resend, but wanted to flag it in case it's a wider issue.

subject: Feature idea: view-only board seats
body: Following on from the sharing link ticket - would it be possible to have a cheaper view-only seat type for board members who just need to check dashboards occasionally? Happy to hear if there's already a way to do this.

subject: Scheduled export to specific folder
body: Could scheduled exports be set to land in a specific shared folder rather than email attachments? Would make our monthly board pack assembly a bit smoother.

subject: Thanks for the export changes - report builder question
body: The folder export option has been great, thank you. Separately, is there a way to duplicate a report template without starting from scratch each quarter? Took a little longer to get an answer on this one but appreciated the detail in the response.

subject: Can't duplicate report template
body: Trying to duplicate an existing report template to use as a base for a new one, but the duplicate option isn't appearing in the menu. Am I missing a permission?

subject: Connector setup for new data source
body: We'd like to add a new data source (Fortnox) as a connector. Could you point us to the setup guide, or is this something your team configures?

subject: Report builder template issue again
body: The duplicate template issue from February happened again on a different template this time. Might be worth checking if it's tied to certain report types.

subject: Alert recipients list not saving
body: When I add extra recipients to an alert, they disappear after saving. Only the original recipient stays. Can you check?

subject: Alerts still missing recipients
body: Picking this back up - the recipient list issue from May is still happening, now on a different alert. Would like this properly fixed rather than re-adding people each time.

subject: Coming back to the alert recipients issue
body: Following up on the alert recipients problem from the summer that never got fully resolved - still dropping people off the list. Can we get proper eyes on this one, it's been open on and off since May.

subject: New report builder issue - column widths reset
body: Different issue this time - column widths I set in a report template reset to default every time it's regenerated. Separate from the alerts problem, wanted to flag while that's being looked at too.

subject: Alert not sending to secondary email
body: Set up an alert with two recipient addresses but only the primary one is receiving it. Can you check the configuration on our account?
